## Checklist

- [ ] The checks in CONTRIBUTING.md pass.
- [ ] I raised `version` in `plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json` if I changed a skill, an advisor or a seat.
- [ ] I have read the code of conduct (CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] No personal data, company-private data, secrets or memory files.
- [ ] New figures carry a source URL and an "as of" date.
- [ ] Seat changes pass the quote checker and keep the simulation label.
- [ ] New roles come with at least 3 eval cases and a `--pointer` result.
